items.statement: Where the labeler code is 5 or 6 digits long, the labeler may pair it either with a 4-digit product code and a 1-digit package code, or with a 3-digit product code and a 2-digit package code, giving an NDC of 10 or 11 digits.
items.quote: If a labeler code is either 5 or 6 digits in length, it may be combined with:

items.statement: Once FDA has assigned an NDC, include a new product code in the proposed new NDC whenever, after initial marketing, there is a change to the drug's established or proprietary name, any active pharmaceutical ingredient or its strength, the dosage form, the prescription/nonprescription status (or for animal drugs prescription, nonprescription or veterinary feed directive status), the intended use between human and animal, or the drug's distinguishing characteristics such as size, shape, color, code imprint, flavor and scoring.
items.quote: The proposed new NDC must include a new product code when there is a change to any of the following information:
items.condition: change to a listed product attribute after initial marketing
